snv_fallback_review.recommendation: Approve the narrow source-only SNP fallback with all stated conditions; shared nonreference background is an assay-context limitation, not loss of an otherwise isolated exact nucleotide contrast.
snv_fallback_review.implementation_status: Production implementation verified in production_final_review; all identity rows independently reproduced with the guarded branch.
mandatory_gates: Require exactly one authoritative primary-assembly GRCh38 mapping, a one-base REF, and start=end.
Require both deposited inserts to contain only A/C/G/T, have equal length, and differ at exactly one position.
Require the two differing bases to equal the reported tested allele pair, contain the local GRCh38 reference base, and identify exactly one explicitly recorded database ALT.
Use a terminal 20-mer identical in both inserts, so the anchor cannot span the tested difference.
Require the terminal anchor to have exactly one match in the reference-check window and infer an insert placement whose differing base maps exactly to the authoritative variant coordinate.
Require the entire inferred insert interval to lie within the fetched reference window.
If both terminal anchors support a placement, require the inferred start coordinates to agree; reject conflicts.
Record every shared background mismatch with position, reference base, construct base, and offset from the tested nucleotide.
Do not apply this fallback to indels, multiple tested changes, differing insert lengths, unresolved source-construct flags, or nonunique genomic mappings.

accepted_example.interpretation: Both alleles share the same nonreference background. The isolated assayed C/G difference maps unambiguously to the exact authoritative nucleotide; do not claim the assay background is the full GRCh38 reference context.

snv_fallback_review.indel_rs142307498: No SNP fallback; unequal-length constructs plus shared context mismatch remain unevaluable under the proposed bounded implementation.
snv_fallback_review.limitation: Terminal-anchor uniqueness is evaluated within the authoritative local locus window; it is not a claim that this 20-mer is globally unique in the genome.

locus_group_review.recommendation: Use the source Figure S1B hg19 displayed locus intervals with the independent GRCh37 mappings, and label this source-defined grouping rather than a new target-gene analysis.
locus_group_review.source_locator: Gong Supplementary Figures S1A-S1B, page1; source hg19_MPRA_SNPs tracks
